facts.summary: Added four detail-query business error codes for custom-dimension reasons, result-set filters, multi-relation metrics, and dynamic-relation metrics, each with an error code, internationalization key, and Chinese fallback message.

When the gray-gated aggregate-filter check finds a grouped filter, it now throws RESULT_SET_FILTER_DETAIL_UNSUPPORTED and passes the filter field name as the replacement argument; empty filters, null configs, and multi-dimensional goal fields retain their prior bypass behavior.

validateCustomDimension continues checking filters, original dimensions, and drill values through customDimensionExpander, but now raises CUSTOM_DIMENSION_DETAIL_REASON_UNSUPPORTED with an empty message argument when any custom dimension is present.

Business-object detail conversion now reports more than three business objects with MULTI_RELATION_METRIC_DETAIL_UNSUPPORTED, HTTP/status argument 403, and an empty message; existing three-object relation branches remain in place.

After normal relation lookups fail, the converter queries related-field metadata on the check object and then theme object; fields recognized as UDF what/what-list fields now raise DYNAMIC_RELATION_METRIC_DETAIL_UNSUPPORTED with status 403, while missing metadata and non-dynamic fields retain their prior fallback errors.

ClickHouse detail topology validation now reports more than three nodes with MULTI_RELATION_METRIC_DETAIL_UNSUPPORTED, status 403, and an empty message; conflicting edge relationships still throw StatDetailDegradeException.
Added a regression test asserting that four business objects produce MULTI_RELATION_METRIC_DETAIL_UNSUPPORTED.
Added tests for dynamic what-field and what-list-field errors, plus fallback behavior for non-dynamic and missing related fields.
Extended tests for self-related topology node reuse, theme-slave md-field mapping, and the multi-relation error when topology contains more than three nodes.
Added repository guidance describing Chinese/i18n handling, error-code usage, legacy matching constants, and compatibility constraints; this is documentation context only.
